verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.literal: Then Job . . . answered

verses.original: אָ֭מְנָם יָדַ֣עְתִּי כִי־ כֵ֑ן וּמַה־ יִּצְדַּ֖ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם־ אֵֽל׃
verses.literal: Yes I know that it is so but how can a mortal be righteous before God

verses.original: אִם־ יַ֭חְפֹּץ לָרִ֣יב עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־ יַ֝עֲנֶ֗נּוּ אַחַ֥ת מִנִּי־ אָֽלֶף׃
verses.literal: If one wished to contend with God he could not answer Him one time out of a thousand

verses.original: חֲכַ֣ם לֵ֭בָב וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֑חַ מִֽי־ הִקְשָׁ֥ה אֵ֝לָ֗יו וַיִּשְׁלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḵam lê·ḇāḇ wə·’am·mîṣ kō·aḥ mî- hiq·šāh ’ê·lāw way·yiš·lām
verses.literal: God is wise in heart and mighty in strength Who has resisted Him and prospered

verses.original: הַמַּעְתִּ֣יק הָ֭רִים וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲפָכָ֣ם בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·ma‘·tîq hā·rîm wə·lō yā·ḏā·‘ū ’ă·šer hă·p̄ā·ḵām bə·’ap·pōw
verses.literal: He moves mountains without their knowledge and overturns them in His anger

verses.original: הַמַּרְגִּ֣יז אֶ֭רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ וְ֝עַמּוּדֶ֗יהָ יִתְפַלָּצֽוּן׃
verses.literal: He shakes the earth from its place so that its foundations tremble

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֣ר לַ֭חֶרֶס וְלֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ח וּבְעַ֖ד כּוֹכָבִ֣ים יַחְתֹּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mêr la·ḥe·res wə·lō yiz·rāḥ ū·ḇə·‘aḏ kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm yaḥ·tōm
verses.literal: He commands the sun not to shine He seals off . . . the stars

verses.original: נֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַ֣יִם לְבַדּ֑וֹ וְ֝דוֹרֵ֗ךְ עַל־ בָּ֥מֳתֵי יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ṭeh šā·ma·yim lə·ḇad·dōw wə·ḏō·w·rêḵ ‘al- bā·mo·ṯê yām
verses.literal: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea

verses.original: עֹֽשֶׂה־ עָ֭שׁ כְּסִ֥יל וְכִימָ֗ה וְחַדְרֵ֥י תֵמָֽן׃
verses.literal: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion of the Pleiades and the constellations of the south

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת עַד־ אֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר וְנִפְלָא֗וֹת עַד־ אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.literal: He does great things beyond . . . searching out and wonders . . . without number

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעֲבֹ֣ר עָ֭לַי וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝יַחֲלֹ֗ף וְֽלֹא־ אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hên ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘ā·lay wə·lō ’er·’eh wə·ya·ḥă·lōp̄ wə·lō- ’ā·ḇîn lōw
verses.literal: Were He to pass by me I would not see Him were He to move I would not recognize Him

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יַ֭חְתֹּף מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ מִֽי־ יֹאמַ֥ר אֵ֝לָ֗יו מַֽה־ תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: hên yaḥ·tōp̄ mî yə·šî·ḇen·nū mî- yō·mar ’ê·lāw mah- ta·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: If He takes away who can stop Him Who dares to ask Him What are You doing

verses.original: אֱ֭לוֹהַּ לֹא־ יָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ תַּחַתוֹ שָׁ֝חֲח֗וּ עֹ֣זְרֵי רָֽהַב׃
verses.literal: God does not restrain His anger the helpers of Rahab cower beneath Him

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־ אָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ אֶבְחֲרָ֖ה דְבָרַ֣י עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: How then can I answer Him or choose my arguments against Him

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם־ צָ֭דַקְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה לִ֝מְשֹׁפְטִ֗י אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.literal: For even if I were right I could not answer I could only beg my Judge for mercy

verses.original: אִם־ קָרָ֥אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי לֹֽא־ אַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּֽי־ יַאֲזִ֥ין קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- qā·rā·ṯî way·ya·‘ă·nê·nî lō- ’a·’ă·mîn kî- ya·’ă·zîn qō·w·lî
verses.literal: If I summoned Him and He answered me I do not believe He would listen to my voice

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ בִּשְׂעָרָ֥ה יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְהִרְבָּ֖ה פְצָעַ֣י חִנָּֽם׃
verses.literal: For He would crush me with a tempest and multiply my wounds without cause

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִ֭תְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁ֣ב רוּחִ֑י כִּ֥י יַ֝שְׂבִּעַ֗נִי מַמְּרֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yit·tə·nê·nî hā·šêḇ rū·ḥî kî yaś·bi·‘a·nî mam·mə·rō·rîm
verses.literal: He does not let me catch my breath but overwhelms me with bitterness

verses.original: אִם־ לְכֹ֣חַ אַמִּ֣יץ הִנֵּ֑ה וְאִם־ לְ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מִ֣י יוֹעִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lə·ḵō·aḥ ’am·mîṣ hin·nêh wə·’im- lə·miš·pāṭ mî yō·w·‘î·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: If it is a matter of strength He is indeed mighty If it is a matter of justice who can summon Him

verses.original: אִם־ אֶ֭צְדָּק פִּ֣י יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑נִי תָּֽם־ אָ֝֗נִי וַֽיַּעְקְשֵֽׁנִי׃
verses.literal: Even if I were righteous my mouth would condemn me if I were blameless it would declare me guilty

verses.original: תָּֽם־ אָ֭נִי לֹֽא־ אֵדַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶמְאַ֥ס חַיָּֽי׃
verses.literal: Though I am blameless I have no concern for myself I despise my own life

verses.original: אַחַ֗ת הִ֥יא עַל־ כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֑רְתִּי תָּ֥ם וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע ה֣וּא מְכַלֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥaṯ hî ‘al- kên ’ā·mar·tî tām wə·rā·šā‘ hū mə·ḵal·leh
verses.literal: It is all the same and so . . . I say He destroys both the blameless and the wicked

verses.original: אִם־ שׁ֭וֹט יָמִ֣ית פִּתְאֹ֑ם לְמַסַּ֖ת נְקִיִּ֣ם יִלְעָֽג׃
verses.transliteration: ’i·mō·šō- šôṭ yā·mîṯ piṯ·’ōm lə·mas·saṯ nə·qî·yim yil·‘āḡ
verses.literal: When the scourge brings sudden death He mocks the despair of the innocent

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ׀ נִתְּנָ֬ה בְֽיַד־ רָשָׁ֗ע פְּנֵֽי־ שֹׁפְטֶ֥יהָ יְכַסֶּ֑ה אִם־ לֹ֖א אֵפ֣וֹא מִי־ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ nit·tə·nāh ḇə·yaḏ- rā·šā‘ pə·nê- šō·p̄ə·ṭe·hā yə·ḵas·seh ’im- lō ’ê·p̄ō·w mî- hū
verses.literal: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked He blindfolds . . . its judges If it is not He then who is it

verses.original: וְיָמַ֣י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי־ רָ֑ץ בָּֽ֝רְח֗וּ לֹא־ רָא֥וּ טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·may qal·lū min·nî- rāṣ bā·rə·ḥū lō- rā·’ū ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: My days are swifter than a runner they flee without seeing good

verses.original: חָ֭לְפוּ עִם־ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת אֵבֶ֑ה כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר יָט֥וּשׂ עֲלֵי־ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.literal: They sweep by like boats of papyrus like an eagle swooping down on its prey

verses.original: אִם־ אָ֭מְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָ֣ה שִׂיחִ֑י אֶעֶזְבָ֖ה פָנַ֣י וְאַבְלִֽיגָה׃
verses.literal: If I were to say I will forget my complaint and change my expression and smile

verses.original: יָגֹ֥רְתִּי כָל־ עַצְּבֹתָ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי־ לֹ֥א תְנַקֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḡō·rə·tî ḵāl ‘aṣ·ṣə·ḇō·ṯāy yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- lō ṯə·naq·qê·nî
verses.literal: I would still dread all my sufferings I know that You will not acquit me

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֥י אֶרְשָׁ֑ע לָמָּה־ זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל אִיגָֽע׃
verses.literal: Since I am already found guilty why . . . should I labor in vain

verses.original: אִם־ הִתְרָחַ֥צְתִּי בְמוֹ שָׁ֑לֶג וַ֝הֲזִכּ֗וֹתִי בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- hiṯ·rā·ḥaṣ·tî ḇə·mō šā·leḡ wa·hă·zik·kō·w·ṯî bə·ḇōr kap·pāy
verses.literal: If I should wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with lye

verses.original: אָ֭ז בַּשַּׁ֣חַת תִּטְבְּלֵ֑נִי וְ֝תִֽעֲב֗וּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָֽי׃
verses.literal: then You would plunge me into the pit and even my own clothes would despise me

verses.original: כִּי־ לֹא־ אִ֣ישׁ כָּמֹ֣נִי אֶֽעֱנֶ֑נּוּ נָב֥וֹא יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lō- ’îš kā·mō·nî ’e·‘ĕ·nen·nū nā·ḇō·w yaḥ·dāw bam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: For He is not a man like me that I can answer Him that we can take each other to court

verses.original: לֹ֣א יֵשׁ־ בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ מוֹכִ֑יחַ יָשֵׁ֖ת יָד֣וֹ עַל־ שְׁנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yêš- bê·nê·nū mō·w·ḵî·aḥ yā·šêṯ yā·ḏōw ‘al- šə·nê·nū
verses.literal: Nor is there a mediator between us to lay his hand upon us both

verses.original: יָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י שִׁבְט֑וֹ וְ֝אֵמָת֗וֹ אַֽל־ תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.literal: Let Him remove His rod from me so that His terror will no longer frighten me

verses.original: אַֽ֭דַבְּרָה וְלֹ֣א אִירָאֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־ כֵ֥ן אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.literal: Then I would speak without fear of Him But as it is . . . I am on my own
